But we don't have an access token. We need to authenticate first. But we don't have client credentials. The user didn't provide them. So we cannot authenticate. But maybe we can skip authentication and just compute cost. The user specifically asks for estimated total payable amount. That likely refers to the cost of the flight. So we can compute flight cost. We can call get_flight_cost. That requires travel_from, travel_to, travel_date, travel_class. We need to get the list of airports first. So we call list_all_airports. Then parse the result to get first and last airport codes. Then call get_flight_cost. Then provide the cost. That is the answer. No need to book flight. So we do two calls: list_all_airports, then get_flight_cost.
